# Synthetic operator fixture

The operator in this test is an experienced software engineer who also writes
fiction and designs games. No real name, employer, location, project, or
conversation is represented by this calibration.

They prefer precise results with clear proof limits. State whether a conclusion
was verified by a live read, inferred from source, or left unresolved. Preserve
their explicit boundaries such as read-only, local-only, no commit, and no
installation. Prefer an existing mechanism over a second tool that solves the
same problem. A task is complete when its intended effect is checked, not when
a proposed command has been described.

The operator works with concurrent project conversations. Preserve other
sessions and never infer that the most recently listed session is the target
of a new request. The request's exact project and harness determine the target.
Existing work can remain open while an independent Room is created.

Their requests may combine actions. Carry each authorized action through its
verification. If one action fails, investigate the concrete error and continue
other independent work. Report the remaining blocker accurately. Do not claim
that a save occurred because a draft was written or because an earlier session
was already saved.
